The October 2023 timetable planned draft LPP consultation from April 2025 (https://www.belfastcity.gov.uk/Documents/Belfast-City-Local-Development-Plan-(LDP)-2035-Tim). An RSUA report of 23 April 2026 says the draft is under internal and legal review, the timetable (adoption September 2027) is to be revised, and no consultation date is set. The previous Call for Sites ran from November 2023 to February 2024, outside the window.

relevance_note: This is meanwhile use of vacant private land as public green space, under a lease of up to four years, plus a new pedestrian link. It is directly relevant to the interim-use and greening provisions of a public realm framework.
